protocol.name: SPA common-state sentence-action consequences v1
protocol.question: At the same real pre-decision state, which valid sentence action has the best declared immediate or later consequence, and does the current policy select it?

body.architecture: 128-wide, two-layer, four-head RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU transformer; hidden 384; 94 Unicode characters; context 64
body.numerical_engine: upstream notorch.c linked with the independent C experiment runner

snapshots.time: Immediately before each ordinary choose call, while the agent is idle.
snapshots.target: (episode_index + decision_index) modulo 4, unchanged from the parent protocol.
snapshots.state: The complete current sentence chain, reseed counters, persistent agent and its private RNG, body parameter bytes, and the ordinary initial host generation stream.

interventions.availability: All and only actions passing nt_spa_action_validate at the original target. Count 60/seed (24 KEEP, 18 LEFT, 18 RIGHT).
interventions.execution: Host intervention directly executes the valid typed action on a private chain/counter copy. No agent choose, observe, imitation, reset or weight replacement occurs in the diagnostic branch.
interventions.initial_host_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f6163746e, episode_index, decision_index), exactly the parent host stream. All alternatives start from this identical stream; KEEP consumes none.

generation.initial_prompt_selection: SplitMix64 samples the sorted corpus sentence-start offsets (first character and the character after .!? followed by whitespace); choose 16 following codepoints.
generation.base_chain: Generate the complete four-sentence chain once per episode and seed; clone it into every arm before intervention. Store every generated token and termination flag.
generation.rng: Independent SplitMix64 generation stream per episode/slot. Reseeds use the same per-seed/episode/decision stream in every arm. Policy RNG is separate.

interventions.reseed_prompt: Last min(3, neighbor_length) character tokens, identical to v1.
interventions.acceptance: Every valid reseed applies; preserve its positive or negative measured consequence.

continuation.horizon_meaning: Number of additional fixed host reseeds after the initial intervention; horizon 0 is its immediate consequence.
continuation.future_action: RESEED_LEFT if future_target>0; otherwise RESEED_RIGHT. This is a frozen diagnostic host continuation and performs no agent learning.
continuation.future_host_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f66757472, episode_index*4 + decision_index, hop), independently constructed at every hop and identical across initial alternatives.
continuation.generation: The same parent 3-character-neighbor, min 12/max 64, temperature 0.8 recipe at every hop.

measurements.target: Seven metrics always refer to the original intervention target index in the current four-sentence chain, including at later horizons.
measurements.before: Snapshot metrics before any intervention, shared by every action/horizon.

axes.local_connectedness: Mean cosine similarity of target to its existing immediate neighbors, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1].
axes.global_connectedness: Unchanged nt_spa_connectedness of target against all other sentence embeddings.
axes.coherence: Mean adjacent sentence cosine similarity mapped to [0,1].
axes.novelty: 1 minus maximum positive cosine similarity between target and any other sentence.
axes.repetition: Repeated character trigrams inside target divided by all target trigrams; zero for fewer than three tokens.
axes.collapse: Fraction of the six unordered sentence pairs with cosine similarity at least 0.98.
axes.continuity: Minimum adjacent sentence cosine similarity mapped to [0,1].

measurements.cost: cumulative_generated_characters / (64 * (horizon+1)); include initial intervention and all fixed continuation generations. KEEP initial cost is 0.
measurements.cost_reporting: Retain initial generated chars, each future generated chars, cumulative chars, and the declared horizon denominator independently of reward.
measurements.interpretation: The later-horizon score measures this fixed continuation and its normalized generation cost. The parent policy continues learning exclusively from its original immediate reward; diagnostic measurements never train it.

comparison.best_actions: All valid actions whose reward is within 1e-7 of the maximum at that snapshot/horizon.
comparison.positive_opportunity: max_action_reward > KEEP_reward + 1e-7 at the same snapshot/horizon.
comparison.selected_regret: max_action_reward minus reward of the ordinary policy-selected action at the snapshot. Report raw value and declare positive only above 1e-7.
comparison.changed_ranking: Compare the complete best-action set at horizon 0 against horizons 1 and 4, retaining ties.
primary: Positive opportunities and selected regrets by seed/horizon.
Action winner sets and their change across horizons.
Raw per-action seven-axis differences and generation costs relative to KEEP.
comparison.historical_result: The parent 0/48 acquired-weight changes and learned/frozen equality remain their registered result.

gates.off_on: Run the complete ordinary host with diagnostics disabled and enabled. Require byte-identical complete original JSONL and all five final canonical life files per seed; require match with pinned parent trace/life identities.
gates.join: Every fork returns with host chain/counters, complete agent, private/ordinary RNG, and body parameter bytes unchanged. Restore the ordinary forward counter and separately report every diagnostic forward.
gates.selected_initial: At horizon 0, the fork for the actual ordinary selected action must reproduce its executed chain, reseed/cost and measured consequence.
gates.pairing: Snapshot life/input hashes and initial host RNG agree for every action; future RNG starting states agree at each hop across alternatives.
gates.completeness: Exactly 24 snapshots, 60 valid forks, 180 horizon measurements per seed, with no duplicates/missing/extra actions. Require complete typed trace plus one terminal summary.
red_hand: A deliberate main-chain mutation is detected.
A deliberate mismatched future RNG is detected.
A deliberate consequence score mutation is detected.
gates.numerical: Each axis/cost/reward finite and range-valid; reward recomputed from independent raw components.

scope.host_tuning: No changes to prompts, cap, temperature, embeddings, action availability or coefficients after observing results.
scope.future_experiments: Neighbor-context length and sentence cap are separate future protocols. No second consumer is added in this round.

reporting.sources: Snapshot all compiled sources; retain compiler flags, binary/source/model/corpus hashes, machine and thread settings.
reporting.artifacts: Complete ordinary/scenario raw records, every action/horizon measurement, negative/tied outcomes, replay comparisons and test receipts. Checkpoints are regenerated, not committed.
